description: BMC Control-M Automation API integration. Each declared job becomes a daily-partitioned Dagster asset with a retry policy. Ships with 5 ops + jobs (restart, hold, free, kill, reconcile), an external-execution monitor sensor, an inbound-trigger sensor, and an hourly reconciliation schedule. demo_mode=true simulates the full Automation API lifecycle on stdout so the whole component runs end-to-end with zero external dependencies.

outputs.description: One daily-partitioned Dagster asset per Control-M job + optional external source-table assets + 5 ops/jobs + 2 sensors + 1 schedule.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Simulate the Automation API on stdout (no external calls).

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Control-M Automation API base URL (used when demo_mode=false).

jobs.label: Jobs
jobs.description: Control-M jobs to wrap as daily-partitioned Dagster assets. Each item: {job_name, asset_name, description?, folder?, application?, sub_application?, host?, run_as?}.

source_tables.label: Source Tables
source_tables.description: Tables loaded by Control-M that Dagster observes (adds to lineage). Each item: {table_name, asset_name, description?, group_name?, produced_by?}.

upstream_deps.label: Upstream Deps
upstream_deps.description: Upstream asset keys (slash-separated for nested keys) that must complete before jobs run.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group for the job assets.

controlm_user_env.label: Control-M User Env Var
controlm_user_env.description: Env var holding the Automation API username.

controlm_password_env.label: Control-M Password Env Var
controlm_password_env.description: Env var holding the Automation API password.

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout Seconds
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Total seconds to wait for terminal status before failing.

spool_retrieval.label: Spool Retrieval
spool_retrieval.description: Retrieve job spool output on completion.

partition_start_date.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start_date.description: Start date for the daily partitioned assets (ODATE origin).

reconciliation_cron.label: Reconciliation Cron
reconciliation_cron.description: Cron for the Control-M vs Dagster state reconciliation job.

name: ControlMIntegration
